body: Live-testing finding for whoever owns the sidecar/renderer next: the app's WebSocket dies silently sometime after boot (cause not root-caused - recorder showed a fresh socket at click time with zero frames sent, the goal dropped mid-reconnect). Fixed loud-and-recoverable in 6780dda: send() on a closed socket now reconnects and start() surfaces the trouble sentence instead of the dead click. OPEN question: WHY the socket dies after a quiet boot - suspect candidates: heartbeat=30 sidecar keepalive vs long model calls, my own repeated CDP reloads, Windows power management on a background window. Repro: launch the app, wait minutes without touching it, click Run - first click occasionally does nothing. Worth a backlog row.
